purpose: Counterexamples for word identity. Each fixture carries both producers' claimed word ranges and the measured speech bursts of the microphone. The product contract: equal words on the same physical speech are one word; a window whose Stop fences are complete outranks an edge-cut live label; one zero-length word cannot void a whole window.
burst_method: RMS per 20 ms hop over int16/32768, speech when > -50 dBFS, gaps < 60 ms merged, bursts >= 60 ms kept
